scenario.job_to_be_done: Expire evidence after one exact approved effect has already completed, remove all future authority, preserve the observed outcome, and tell the recruiter that an external follow-up remains.

proofs: The action passed exact-preview approval and the deterministic adapter independently observed the expected destination state.
Authorization expiry preserved the action as completed and preserved the verified outcome; neither was represented as undone.
The source and future evidence-derived authority became unavailable, and the prior Wiki was replaced.
The expiration response counted one completed external effect requiring recruiter follow-up.
The relationship Agent history showed a system-authored expiration operation whose detail said that one external effect requires recruiter follow-up.
The same relationship projection named the exact action, destination, attempt, observation, outcome, authorization decision, and requirement for a recruiter decision.
The manual revoke and renewal completion message uses the same count and explicitly says that nothing already completed was represented as undone.

boundary_checks.human_decision: A reviewer granted exact-preview approval before execution. Expiry enforced an existing deadline and did not create a new effect.
boundary_checks.reversibility: Only future authority and derived memory were removed. The observed completed effect remained immutable evidence.
boundary_checks.truthful_copy: The product says follow-up is required; it does not say the message, calendar entry, or other external effect was reversed.
boundary_checks.production_boundary: The effect was a labeled local simulation and proves state semantics, not a production connector.

verification.runtime_result: Exact approval, verified execution, expiry, outcome preservation, replacement Wiki, count propagation, Agent-history warning, and exact follow-up lineage all passed.

limitations: The exact follow-up projection was runtime-proven for one completed effect; a mixed completed-and-unknown multi-effect scenario remains unproven.
The Web drawer is covered by type checks and production build but has not received a new screenshot-level visual review in this slice.
No real candidate message, calendar event, ATS, CRM, or contact write occurred.
